description: Land Acquistion - Medawalamulla South, Galle Four Gravets D/S/D, Galle District
categorisation: The gazette content is a formal notice under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing the government's intention to acquire specific plots of land (Lot Nos. 117, 118, 119) for a public purpose. It provides legal descriptions, locations, extents, and claimant information. The primary subject matter is land acquisition, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category for land and property-related administrative matters. It does not involve government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories as its core function.
